classification: (b) the stage was wrong: a missed place, not a wrong expectation and not a product defect
cause: The quote proves its source vector is complete by comparing cp7_credit.initial_base_events_v1(sale) with the Native source collector ow04_source_proposal.locked_source_family(sale)->events (02_initial_projection.sql:333). The consumer composition extended initial_base_events_v1 with the invoice's incoming credit as FUNDING events (consumer_incoming_funding_v1); the Native collector has no consumer events. On an invoice that received credit the two vectors therefore differ by exactly those events, and the retained check correctly refused. Slice C had removed the APPLY clause (C1) without adding the incoming events to the Native side. The first-return quotes and the protected refusals passed; install, removal before use, CP6 restore and the advisor gate passed.
fix: C13: one counted substitution in the quote so the Native side is (src->events) || consumer_incoming_funding_v1(sale): the exact incoming events, each proven by consumer_event_data_v1 inside that function. Without incoming credit the added list is empty and the check is the slice B check; with it the exact vector is accepted, and a vector missing an incoming event is still refused (local_check_delta.py). The native-empty direct route keeps its own unchanged check (C8). No case expectation or oracle was changed; the six blocked cases and the race are unproven until the next run.
